name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Apple Lime Ginger Energy (4:1 THC:CBG)
description: Introducing "Nom Nom Edible Co's" latest creation: the ultimate energy boost in a delectable form. Our 200mg THC edible combines the stimulating power of yerba mate with the zesty fusion of apple, lime, and ginger, delivering a flavor sensation like no other. Each bite-sized delight is meticulously crafted to provide a balanced high, perfect for those seeking a pick-me-up during their adventures or daily routines. With Nom Nom Edible Co, you're not just indulging in a treat – you're unlocking a flavorful journey infused with natural energy and THC goodness.
